audit.whatIsWrong: matchup-lint findings left over from the propose pass (MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Lint is absolute, not baseline-relative; the QA pass owns these classes. Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every cooldown written here is copied from champ-data/_kits/<slug>.json (Riot Data Dragon), not inferred.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Playful / Trickster like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, 8s maxed. The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo, so bait it before spending burst. - Yours is on the same clock; guard it. - Chum the Waters is 120s: kill windows only.

edits.before: Q through him, W bleed, walk out through the wave — the fish phases in and out before his answer finds a target.
edits.after: Seastone Trident is 7s at rank 1 and 3s maxed — start the bleed first and the mirror's damage race is already decided.

edits.before: Hopping in first against a held CC — the pole spent as an entrance is the whole kit spent as a coin flip.
edits.after: Chum the Waters is slow over 1300 range — sidestep the throw; once the fish sticks, his 120s ult is a free knockup.

notes: QA LINT PASS (2026-08-24): applied 3 mechanical fix(es) for matchup-lint classes MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT. Cooldowns quoted from champ-data/_kits; pronouns from champ-data/champ-gender.js. No new claims about spell-shield eligibility, cleanse, tenacity or animation cancels were introduced.
